derivedFrom.note: The stamp that makes a mixed record detectable. `scope` and `results` are computed from the `handoffRun` in this file and describe no other run; any command that reads this record refuses it outright if this id and `handoffRun.keymap.runId` disagree.

scope.countsAreDerived: Every number in this block is computed by scripts/lib/art-score.mjs from the `handoffRun` beside it, by `verify-art record`, and is recomputed whole on every record. Nobody types these, and they cannot describe a different run than `handoffRun` does. `make verify-art` reports the same figures.

unrendered.why: UNRENDERED, by decision. No source answers this subject. `layer-20-skyline.svg` is a GENERIC winter city and must stay generic: it is a repeating parallax tile that the medium and low presets drop, and the art bible forbids putting an identifying feature on a droppable layer. A verifier that could name Ottawa from it would be reporting a defect, not a pass. The Hill's own skyline features live in `landmark-parliament-hill.svg`, which is judged as `peace-tower`.
